1. Structural Collapse (Glass Handles): Severity 2.5 is appropriate. The handles merge into the body without clear negative space, a common AI failure in transparent objects.
2. Texture Anomaly (Reflections): Severity 1.5 is conservative. The 'painted' look of the refractions is quite noticeable and breaks photorealism. I would rate this closer to 2.0-2.5 as it significantly impacts the quality of the dominant object.
3. Perspective Distortion (Cup Handle): Severity 1.0 is fair; it's a minor blur/fusion issue.
